Claire —

Attached is the first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a compact week-by-week GANTT. Highlights and asks:

1) Phased scope (weeks denote calendar weeks):
   - Week 1–2: Security questionnaire + SOC2 artifact handover (owner: Ben)
   - Week 3–4: Sandbox provisioning, model validation with sample data (owner: Mina)
   - Week 5–7: Integration (server-side embedding endpoints, in-app generation hooks) + QA (owner: Marissa)
   - Week 8–9: Staging load and acceptance tests; cutover plan (owner: Marissa)

2) Critical dates:
   - Procurement decision window requested: Apr 12–16 (Claire to confirm)
   - Compliance blackout: May 22–28 (we will not schedule cutovers that week)
   - Target go-live: Jun 15 — contingency Jun 22 if acceptance slips

3) Victory conditions (so we’re aligned on acceptance):
   - Functional: embeddings index > 95% relevance on test prompts per eval set
   - Performance: 95th percentile latency < 300ms in staging under 100r/s synthetic load
   - Ops: documented rollback steps + runbook handed to Lily SRE

4) Dependencies and risks:
   - Data access (PII filters) must be ready by Apr 9 or model validation slips
   - Procurement signature before Apr 20 to keep current resource slot

5) Immediate asks from Lily:
   - Can you confirm internal reviewers for SOC2 artifacts? (Ben will send a shortlist of artifacts)
   - Please add procurement@lilyhealth.com to the SOW thread so Ben can feed procurement items directly.

Attachments: LilyHealth_MAP_v1.3.xlsx; Onboarding-Week-by-Week-GANTT.pdf; SOW-draft-lilyhealth.docx

I’ll host a 30-minute readout tomorrow to walk through the MAP and assign final owners — Thu Apr 3 at 10am PT. If that doesn’t work for your team, please propose an alternate time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

— Priyom Das
